d:
Shaggy, choppy-cut hair in a pale ash blonde shade with long, uneven bangs framing the face. Sharp, narrow eyes in a muted slate grey shade. An adolescent appearance with a pale, youthful complexion. A slender, petite build. A black tactical leather jacket over a dark grey ribbed turtleneck and black combat trousers. A small, silver earring in the left ear and a dark grey utility belt.
BODY COLOR: pale beige
